info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1
info.description: Secure REST API (Node, Express, MongoDB). Run the folders in order (Runner). Login requests save tokenA/tokenB automatically; create requests save johnId/janeId. Signup and login share a rate limit (default 10 requests per 15 minutes). For a full Runner pass, set AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100 in .env and restart the server, or restart it between folders. The rate limit request must be sent 11 times with the default limit: the 11th returns 429.
